scripts.build:bin: bun build --compile src/main.tsx --outfile dist/Tinytext && cp node_modules/@gpuix/native-darwin-arm64/gpuix-native.darwin-arm64.node dist/
scripts.build:app: bun run build:bin && cargo packager --release --config "$(bun -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(await Bun.file("packager.json").json()))')"
scripts.build:dmg: bun run build:bin && cargo packager --release --config "$(bun -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(await Bun.file("packager-dmg.json").json()))')"
